status: illustrative planning only; assumptions are not observed data or stakeholder approvals
assumptions_notice: Conversion rates, minimum lifts, opportunity counts, net revenue, margin, and campaign costs are hypothetical. Three decision tests use a Bonferroni per-test alpha to control family-wise two-sided error at 5%. The calculation assumes independent binary outcomes, equal assignment, no clustering, and no attrition. Replace with reconciled source-system data and approved finance inputs before launch.

decisions.hypothesis: A Reel-led creative generates a commercially useful increase in attributed purchase conversion versus an Image-led creative.
decisions.comparison: Randomly split eligible audience into Image (control) and Reel (treatment); hold offer, audience, spend, placement, and measurement window constant.
decisions.randomization_unit: Mutually exclusive platform audience members assigned before exposure.
decisions.primary_outcome: Attributed purchase conversions / pre-treatment eligible audience members (intention to treat).
decisions.guardrails: Net contribution per assigned member, paid cost per purchase, reach delivery, negative feedback, and brand-safety review.
decisions.success_action: If lift is at least 0.30 percentage points, its Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided 98.33% interval excludes zero, net contribution is positive with its preregistered uncertainty interval excluding zero, and guardrails pass, shift at most 10% of the next comparable test budget to Reels, then replicate.
decisions.inconclusive_action: Keep the current allocation; do not call a winner. Re-estimate power only after checking delivery, contamination, and outcome maturity.
decisions.harm_action: Stop the treatment and return to the control if the pre-agreed harm boundary is crossed or net contribution is negative at the fixed analysis.

decisions.decision: Campaign message: Tutorial or Product Launch
decisions.hypothesis: A Tutorial message increases attributed purchase conversion versus a Product Launch message when format, offer, and audience are held constant.
decisions.comparison: Randomize eligible audience to Tutorial (control) or Product Launch (treatment) messaging using the same creative format and offer.
decisions.randomization_unit: Mutually exclusive platform audience members assigned before exposure.
decisions.primary_outcome: Attributed purchase conversions / pre-treatment eligible audience members (intention to treat).
decisions.guardrails: Net contribution per assigned member, paid cost per purchase, reach delivery, negative feedback, and brand-safety review.
decisions.success_action: If lift is at least 0.20 percentage points, its Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided 98.33% interval excludes zero, net contribution is positive with its preregistered uncertainty interval excluding zero, and guardrails pass, use the Product Launch message in a limited rollout and replicate.
decisions.inconclusive_action: Keep the current message mix; refine the hypothesis or collect a properly powered new test rather than selecting the higher observed rate.
decisions.harm_action: Stop the treatment and return to the control if the pre-agreed harm boundary is crossed or net contribution is negative at the fixed analysis.

decisions.decision: Paid allocation: current mix or tested-format reallocation
decisions.hypothesis: A capped 10% reallocation toward the winning tested format increases net contribution per assigned audience member at the same total spend.
decisions.comparison: Randomize mutually exclusive audience cells to the current paid mix (control) or proposed mix (treatment); keep total spend, eligibility, and campaign window equal.
decisions.randomization_unit: Mutually exclusive audience cells assigned before paid exposure; recalculate power for any cluster-level assignment.
decisions.primary_outcome: Attributed purchase conversions / pre-treatment assigned audience members; net contribution after paid media cost per assigned member is the Finance scale-up gate (the sample-size calculation does not power this continuous outcome).
decisions.guardrails: Attributed purchase conversion rate, cost per purchase, spend cap, reach delivery, negative feedback, and brand safety.
decisions.success_action: If the conversion lift reaches 0.40 percentage points with its Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided 98.33% interval excluding zero, net contribution is positive with its preregistered uncertainty interval excluding zero, conversion and spend guardrails pass, and Finance reconciles the costs, roll out the 10% reallocation for one cycle and review again.
decisions.inconclusive_action: Retain the current mix and spend cap; do not reallocate based on engagement or attributed ROAS alone.
decisions.harm_action: Revert to the control mix immediately if the approved spend cap or harm guardrail is breached.
